checks.note: Acme Fastening is called "a rival" and is never named. HomeMax is a customer, not a competitor, and isn't named either.
Bullet 1 covers the 61% concentration in two big-box customers and the unrenewed contract that expires in Q1. HomeMax isn't named, but the risk is fully there.
Bullet 2 ties the drop from 42% to 38% to the 36% covenant on the $20M line renewing in December. Bullet 3 adds the steel cost driver.

Every figure ($41.2M vs $43M, 38%/42%, 15%, 61%, 140 days, 4 months / $1.1M, $20M, 36%) comes from the report. "Four points" is correctly worked out from those numbers. One small stretch: the report says the covenant requires "margin" above 36%, and the answer calls it "gross margin." That reading is reasonable but not stated in the report.
